form: This schedule is preliminary and will be revised. All times are in the Vancouver (BC, Canada) time zone.
Sessions 1-8 are scheduled talks on a range of languages and linguistic topics.
Sessions A and C are thematic sessions with two talks followed by open discussion on the themes (open to all participants).
Session B is dedicated to community and language updates.
There will be a business meeting/social on Saturday evening.
